artifact.status_search_result: No definitive published proof of this specific supercongruence package (with the binary-form representation cases for the discriminant-related forms attached to 105) was located. Such Z.-W. Sun-type conjectures on supercongruences with 9-case decomposition involving primes splitting in $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-105})$, $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-35})$, etc., are generally still open, though some related Ramanujan-type series for $1/\pi$ have been proved by WZ or modular methods. Status here is unverified.
